failure_contract.meaning: Fail closed; do not render a successful exposure panel.
Stable frozen validation terminology, not numerical fallback.
Retain check_id, error_code, error_type, message and safely available context.
No successful primary state when validation fails.
No TOP/MULTIPLE/INSUFFICIENT success response substituted for artifact failure.
Show safe unavailable/validation message; retain error details for diagnostics; no RF/legacy/default fallback.
Preserve failure envelope; transport status may be defined later, but never signal successful exposure data.
Never silently produce success; internal helpers may raise and the documented validation_boundary standardizes expected artifact failures.

freeze_usage: Frozen byte copy loaded with explicit repository root via load_engine(root). No business-logic refactor; source CLI root inference depends on file location, so pass --root explicitly if invoking frozen CLI.
limitations: Historical source-taxonomy correspondence and exact inclusion boundaries have limitations.
Modern O*NET mapping does not make a historical value current.
Complete local source/Wocke extraction lineage has not been independently reproduced; reference code/title verification is a separate claim.
Historical occupation-level exposure is not current generative-AI risk, personal automation probability or probability of losing a job.
US-origin reference evidence may not generalize to other labor markets.
Coverage is data availability, not accuracy, semantic equivalence or inference confidence.
TOP inference does not verify current employment; CV role chronology may remain unresolved.
EQUIVALENT retains recorded scope/current-historical limitations; broader and overlap values are contextual source references.
